mapper.sql: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_principal principal JOIN employee self_employee ON self_employee.employee_id = principal.employee_id AND self_employee.company_id = projection.company_id JOIN employee_current_projection employee_projection ON employee_projection.employee_id = self_employee.employee_id JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_version_id = employee_projection.current_version_id AND employee_version.employee_id = self_employee.employee_id AND employee_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee_version.effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND ( employee_version.effective_to IS NULL OR employee_version.effective_to > #{businessDate} ) JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment role_assignment ON role_assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_role_capability role_capability ON role_capability.role_id = role_assignment.role_id JOIN auth_capability capability ON capability.capability_id = role_capability.capability_id AND capability.capability_code = #{capabilityCode} AND capability.capability_code = 'ATTENDANCE_SELF:READ' JOIN auth_data_scope data_scope ON data_scope.scope_id = role_assignment.data_scope_id AND data_scope.scope_type = 'SELF' AND data_scope.organization_id IS NULL AND ( data_scope.company_id IS NULL OR data_scope.company_id = self_employee.company_id ) WHERE principal.principal_id = #{principalId} AND principal.status = 'ACTIVE' AND principal.employee_id IS NOT NULL AND role_assignment.valid_from <= #{authorizationTime} AND ( role_assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR role_assignment.valid_to > #{authorizationTime} ) AND data_scope.valid_from <= #{authorizationTime} AND ( data_scope.valid_to IS NULL OR data_scope.valid_to > #{authorizationTime} ) )

EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_principal principal JOIN employee self_employee ON self_employee.employee_id = principal.employee_id AND self_employee.employee_id = fact.employee_id AND self_employee.company_id = fact.company_id JOIN employee_current_projection employee_projection ON employee_projection.employee_id = self_employee.employee_id JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_version_id = employee_projection.current_version_id AND employee_version.employee_id = self_employee.employee_id AND employee_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee_version.effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND ( employee_version.effective_to IS NULL OR employee_version.effective_to > #{businessDate} ) JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment role_assignment ON role_assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_role_capability role_capability ON role_capability.role_id = role_assignment.role_id JOIN auth_capability capability ON capability.capability_id = role_capability.capability_id AND capability.capability_code = #{capabilityCode} AND capability.capability_code = 'ATTENDANCE_SELF:READ' JOIN auth_data_scope data_scope ON data_scope.scope_id = role_assignment.data_scope_id AND data_scope.scope_type = 'SELF' AND data_scope.organization_id IS NULL AND ( data_scope.company_id IS NULL OR data_scope.company_id = self_employee.company_id ) WHERE principal.principal_id = #{principalId} AND principal.status = 'ACTIVE' AND principal.employee_id IS NOT NULL AND principal.employee_id = fact.employee_id AND projection.attendance_report_projection_id = fact.attendance_report_projection_id AND projection.company_id = fact.company_id AND projection.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND role_assignment.valid_from <= #{authorizationTime} AND ( role_assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR role_assignment.valid_to > #{authorizationTime} ) AND data_scope.valid_from <= #{authorizationTime} AND ( data_scope.valid_to IS NULL OR data_scope.valid_to > #{authorizationTime} ) )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT principal.employee_id, self_employee.company_id FROM auth_principal principal JOIN employee self_employee ON self_employee.employee_id = principal.employee_id JOIN company company ON company.company_id = self_employee.company_id AND company.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN employee_current_projection employee_projection ON employee_projection.employee_id = self_employee.employee_id JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_version_id = employee_projection.current_version_id AND employee_version.employee_id = self_employee.employee_id AND employee_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee_version.effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND ( employee_version.effective_to IS NULL OR employee_version.effective_to > #{businessDate} ) JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment role_assignment ON role_assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_role_capability role_capability ON role_capability.role_id = role_assignment.role_id JOIN auth_capability capability ON capability.capability_id = role_capability.capability_id AND capability.capability_code = #{capabilityCode} AND capability.capability_code = 'ATTENDANCE_SELF:READ' JOIN auth_data_scope data_scope ON data_scope.scope_id = role_assignment.data_scope_id AND data_scope.scope_type = 'SELF' AND data_scope.organization_id IS NULL AND ( data_scope.company_id IS NULL OR data_scope.company_id = self_employee.company_id ) WHERE principal.principal_id = #{principalId} AND principal.status = 'ACTIVE' AND principal.employee_id IS NOT NULL AND role_assignment.valid_from <= #{authorizationTime} AND ( role_assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR role_assignment.valid_to > #{authorizationTime} ) AND data_scope.valid_from <= #{authorizationTime} AND ( data_scope.valid_to IS NULL OR data_scope.valid_to > #{authorizationTime} ) ORDER BY principal.employee_id, self_employee.company_id LIMIT 2

SELECT projection.attendance_report_projection_id AS projection_id, projection.company_id, projection.projection_version, projection.source_versions_json, projection.data_as_of, projection.period_state FROM attendance_report_projection projection WHERE projection.company_id = #{companyId} AND projection.period_start = #{periodStart} AND projection.period_end_exclusive = #{periodEndExclusive} AND projection.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND projection.published_at <= #{authorizationTime} AND AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_report_projection newer_projection WHERE newer_projection.company_id = projection.company_id AND newer_projection.period_start = #{periodStart} AND newer_projection.period_end_exclusive = #{periodEndExclusive} AND newer_projection.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND newer_projection.published_at <= #{authorizationTime} AND ( newer_projection.published_at > projection.published_at OR ( newer_projection.published_at = projection.published_at AND newer_projection .attendance_report_projection_id > projection .attendance_report_projection_id ) ) ) ORDER BY projection.published_at DESC, projection.attendance_report_projection_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT fact.business_date, fact.shift_label, fact.scheduled_minutes, fact.confirmed_scheduled_work_minutes AS confirmed_minutes, fact.recognized_overtime_minutes, fact.leave_or_time_off_minutes AS leave_minutes, fact.first_punch_at, fact.last_punch_at FROM attendance_report_daily_fact fact JOIN attendance_report_projection projection ON projection.attendance_report_projection_id = fact.attendance_report_projection_id AND projection.company_id = fact.company_id WHERE fact.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND fact.company_id = #{companyId} AND fact.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND fact.business_date <= #{businessDate} AND ORDER BY fact.business_date

SELECT fact.business_date, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM attendance_report_exception_fact fact JOIN attendance_report_projection projection ON projection.attendance_report_projection_id = fact.attendance_report_projection_id AND projection.company_id = fact.company_id WHERE fact.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND fact.company_id = #{companyId} AND fact.business_date >= #{trendStart} AND fact.business_date <= #{businessDate} AND fact.state IN ( 'OPEN', 'PENDING_EVIDENCE', 'PENDING_REVIEW' ) AND GROUP BY fact.business_date ORDER BY fact.business_date

SELECT DISTINCT fact.exception_type AS issue_label FROM attendance_report_exception_fact fact JOIN attendance_report_projection projection ON projection.attendance_report_projection_id = fact.attendance_report_projection_id AND projection.company_id = fact.company_id WHERE fact.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND fact.company_id = #{companyId} AND fact.business_date = #{businessDate} AND fact.state IN ( 'OPEN', 'PENDING_EVIDENCE', 'PENDING_REVIEW' ) AND ORDER BY fact.exception_type

SELECT fact.exception_type AS type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM attendance_report_exception_fact fact JOIN attendance_report_projection projection ON projection.attendance_report_projection_id = fact.attendance_report_projection_id AND projection.company_id = fact.company_id WHERE fact.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND fact.company_id = #{companyId} AND fact.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND fact.business_date <= #{businessDate} AND fact.state IN ( 'OPEN', 'PENDING_EVIDENCE', 'PENDING_REVIEW' ) AND GROUP BY fact.exception_type ORDER BY count DESC, fact.exception_type

SELECT fact.business_date, fact.exception_type AS type, fact.severity, fact.state, fact.exception_minutes AS minutes, fact.safe_evidence_summary FROM attendance_report_exception_fact fact JOIN attendance_report_projection projection ON projection.attendance_report_projection_id = fact.attendance_report_projection_id AND projection.company_id = fact.company_id WHERE fact.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND fact.company_id = #{companyId} AND fact.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND fact.business_date <= #{businessDate} AND fact.state IN ( 'OPEN', 'PENDING_EVIDENCE', 'PENDING_REVIEW' ) AND ORDER BY fact.business_date DESC, CASE fact.severity WHEN 'ERROR' THEN 0 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CASE fact.state WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 0 WHEN 'PENDING_REVIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, fact.exception_type, fact.exception_case_id LIMIT 10
